description: OpenAI Codex CLI (codex exec), the local command-line runtime: a member is dispatched non-interactively in its own clone and its work returns as patches; a read-only member is held by the Codex sandbox in read-only mode, a write member by workspace-write mode

*.source: no --model is passed in the dispatch argv: codex exec uses the signed-in account's default model (codex exec --help); no model id is asserted by this definition

notes.barrier: The barrier is Codex's own sandbox flags (workspace-write or read-only); this runtime has no crown guard hook. crown local verify — refs unchanged, tree clean — is the backstop, and the read-only class counts as not supported until a live read-only run attests that the sandbox holds.
notes.environment: Every member receives CODEX_HOME, which holds the account's Codex login, and the standard proxy variables: the member runs as the signed-in account over the host's network route. Both are passed on purpose.
notes.models: Effort is wired via -c model_reasoning_effort: crown low, medium, high and xhigh map to the Codex values of the same name; max has no Codex control and is dropped with a note. Model selection is not wired: the dispatch passes no --model and every member runs the signed-in account's default model. The pattern accepts only the account-default id, so a role that names another model id is refused, not silently ignored; to change the model, change the Codex account's default.
